about: Shared model-level case list for cmux NEXT (cx-gkyi1; HID side cx-hdyx4). One file, three runners: headless Swift (ModelMatrixTests: schema and entry resolution through the action catalog), headless core (cmux-tui-core mux::tests::matrix: each case's `core` steps on the real daemon core; the tier "headless" means both headless runners) and the real-HID / monkey runners in cmuxterm-hq tools/baseline. Failure messages start with "MATRIX <case id>:". `$new` names the object the case's action creates. A case with `steps` runs them in order; a step may repeat and may carry its own `expect`.

invariants.no-crash: The runner finished every step; nothing panicked or crashed.
invariants.layout-valid: Layout invariants hold after every step: no tab lost or placed twice, no empty pane, column or screen, each pane placed once (daemon check_state / validate_layout_transition).
invariants.items-kept: Every object of `of` that existed before still exists (a superset; new objects allowed).
invariants.item-set-kept: The set of `of` objects is exactly the same before and after (moves and reorders only).
invariants.count-delta: The number of `of` objects (in `in` when given) changed by `by`.
invariants.order-is: The objects of `of` (in `in` when given) are in exactly the order `ids`.
invariants.selected-is: The selected `of` (workspace, or tab in `in`) is `id`.
invariants.zoomed-is: The zoomed pane of the workspace is `id` (null: none).
invariants.answers-within-ms: The action's visible result shows within `ms` milliseconds (hid and monkey tiers; the headless tiers have no wall clock).
invariants.restored-equal: After quit and relaunch the layout and selection equal the state before (hid tier).

palette.note: The command palette row of the action.

menu.note: The action's main menu bar item.

context-menu.note: A right-click menu placement of the action.

cli.note: `cmux action run <id> --focus` with the target: a user-origin run. Without --focus the CLI never changes the view (ActionInvocation.allowsViewChange).

strip-plus.note: The tab strip's + button: TabStripIntent.newTab -> StripNewTab.request.

sidebar.note: The sidebar's + button. It calls WindowManager.newWorkspace directly, not an action (SidebarBridge+Intents).

drag.note: A mouse drag that does what the action does (sidebar row, tab, tab onto a pane edge or another workspace).

of.tabs: tabs placed in the layout (a closed pane's terminals may survive detached; they don't count)

vocabulary.target: The object the action acts on. palette, menu, shortcut and strip-plus runners focus or select it first; context-menu right-clicks it; cli passes it; drag drags it.
